$comment: STATIC COPY, not placeholder records — there is no GET /admin/overview/vocabularies to build. These are the definitions behind every ⓘ on #/overview: what a figure means, how it is computed, what it includes and which clock it runs on. The Overview stores NOTHING of its own: every number is derived in src/admin/views/Overview/store.ts from the Deals API, the Finance store, the Team store and the Enquiries API. When a server-side GET /admin/overview lands (see BACKEND-INTEGRATION.md § Module 10) it must compute each metric exactly as `how` says, or the tile and the module it drills into will disagree.

collected.label: Collected
collected.what: Money that actually arrived in the period — subscription installments plus other income.
collected.how: Σ installment payments by value date + Σ incoming company transactions, inside the period. Refunds paid out are not subtracted here; they show under Out.
collected.includes: Finance → Subscriptions and Other Transaction. Never deal values.
collected.period: The selected period, on the Finance clock. Compared with the same number of days immediately before it.

pipeline.label: Pipeline value
pipeline.what: The total value of every deal that is still open.
pipeline.how: Σ deal value over deals whose stage is before Won. A deal with no value yet is counted in the number of deals but adds nothing to the value.
pipeline.includes: Every deal the signed-in session can see. A scoped session sees its own pipeline, not the company's.
pipeline.period: Right now — not a period figure. Live from the Deals API.

won.label: Won
won.what: Deals that reached Won in the period, and what they were worth.
won.how: Count and Σ value of deals whose current stage is Won and whose stage-since date falls in the period.
won.includes: Only deals still at Won today. A won deal later moved back is not counted.
won.period: The selected period, on the live clock. Compared with the period before it.

conversion.label: Conversion
conversion.what: Of the deals that closed in the period, the share that closed as Won.
conversion.how: Won ÷ (Won + Lost) × 100, both counted by the date they reached that stage. Shows — when nothing closed.
conversion.includes: Closed deals only. Open deals do not lower the rate.
conversion.period: The selected period, on the live clock. Compared with the period before it.

outstanding.label: Receivable
outstanding.what: Subscription money that has been agreed and has not arrived.
outstanding.how: Σ installments still due + Σ installments that failed to pay, across every subscription.
outstanding.includes: Finance → Subscriptions. Deal values with no subscription behind them are not receivable yet.
outstanding.period: All time, as of the Finance clock.

team.label: Team
team.what: Active members, and how many have opened their day so far.
team.how: Members with status active. Present = a member with an attendance row today, whatever state it is in now.

overdue.label: Overdue tasks
overdue.what: Open work items past their due date.
overdue.how: Items that are not completed or cancelled and whose due date is before today. Derived, never stored — the same rule the Tasks board uses.
overdue.includes: Tasks, milestones and targets, across the whole team.
overdue.period: Right now, on the Team clock.

enquiries.label: Enquiries
enquiries.what: New business enquiries received in the last seven days.
enquiries.how: Counted by the server over everything received in the last 7 days, regardless of any filter set in the Enquiries queue.
enquiries.includes: Every source — website, calls, walk-ins. Live.
enquiries.period: The last 7 days, always. This tile ignores the period picker because the API counts fixed windows.

health.label: Health
health.what: Four yes-or-no reads on the parts of the business that fail quietly.
health.how: Pipeline: share of open deals flagged stalled (under 15% ok, under 35% watch). Collections: any failed installment is a problem, any overdue installment is a watch. Team: on-time arrivals over the period (85% ok, 65% watch). Delivery: share of open tasks that are overdue (under 10% ok, under 30% watch).
health.includes: One read per area. It is not a score and is not averaged.
health.period: Mixed — each read names its own window behind its dot.

dealflow.label: Deal flow
dealflow.what: How many deals were created, won and lost in each slice of the period.
dealflow.how: Created by created date. Won and Lost by the date the deal reached that stage. Grouped by day, week or month depending on how long the period is.
dealflow.includes: Every deal the session can see. Lost is counted so a quiet chart is not mistaken for a good one.
dealflow.period: The selected period, on the live clock.

moneyflow.label: Money in and out
moneyflow.what: What arrived and what left in each slice of the period.
moneyflow.how: In = installments collected + other income. Out = salaries paid + other outgoing + refunds paid. Each slice uses the same arithmetic as Finance → Analytics for that date range.
moneyflow.includes: Finance records only. Tax-excluded transactions are counted apart, as they are in Finance.
moneyflow.period: The selected period, on the Finance clock.

funnel.label: Pipeline by stage
funnel.what: Where the open deals sit right now, and what each stage is worth.
funnel.how: Count and Σ value of deals currently at each stage. Won is every deal at Won today, not only this period's.
funnel.includes: Lost is left off the funnel — it is the exit, not a stage.

byowner.label: By owner
byowner.what: Who is carrying the open pipeline.
byowner.how: Open deals grouped by owner: count, Σ value, and how many they won in the period.
byowner.includes: Owner only — a co-owner is not credited here.
byowner.period: Open now; won in the selected period.

lens.label: Deals that need a look
lens.what: Four ways to rank the open pipeline.
lens.how: At risk: stalled, next action overdue, or expected close in the past — biggest first. Closing soon: expected close within 14 days. Highest value: by value. Longest in stage: by days since the stage changed.

teamtable.label: Team performance
teamtable.what: One row per member: their deals, what their deals have collected, their tasks and their attendance.
teamtable.how: Deals: open deals owned. Collected: Σ revenue collected on deals they own, all time — the Deals API carries no payment dates. Tasks: completed in the period ÷ open now ÷ overdue now. On time: arrivals not marked late over working days in the period.
teamtable.includes: Active members. Attendance and tasks come from the Team store; deals and money from the Deals API, joined on the owner.
teamtable.period: Tasks completed and attendance use the selected period; deals and load are as of now.

load.label: Load
load.what: How much open work a member is carrying, against the busiest person on the team.
load.how: Open items ÷ the highest open count on the team. Red when three or more of theirs are overdue.
load.includes: Tasks, milestones and targets assigned to them.

net.label: Net
net.what: Cash movement for the period: what came in minus what went out.
net.how: Collected + other income − salaries paid − other outgoing − refunds paid. Cash, not profit.
net.includes: The same records Finance → Analytics reads.
net.period: The selected period, on the Finance clock. Compared with the period before it.

duesoon.label: Due in 30 days
duesoon.what: Installments that fall due in the next thirty days.
duesoon.how: Σ amount of installments with status due and a due date between today and today + 30.

payroll.label: Payroll owed
payroll.what: Salary that has been run and not paid.
payroll.how: Σ net of slips in runs that are still open, plus any slip held back.
payroll.includes: Only shown to a session holding Salaries A/C access.

ops.label: Operations
ops.what: Where execution is blocked on a person.
ops.how: Each line is a count from the Team store: overdue and due-this-week tasks, today's attendance states, plans and end-of-day reports still owed, reports not yet read, leave waiting on a decision, agreements sent and not opened, onboarding documents missing.
ops.includes: The founder is excluded from plan and report counts, as in Reports.
ops.period: Today on the Team clock; tasks completed use the selected period.

attention.label: Needs attention
attention.what: Everything on this page that is a problem, in one ranked list.
attention.how: Rules, not opinions: a stalled deal, an overdue next action, a passed close date, a failed installment, a refund owed, an unexplained bank line, an overdue urgent task, a member with three or more late items, a missing plan or report, an unclosed day, leave waiting, an agreement about to expire, collections or conversion falling by a fifth against the previous period. Ranked by severity, then by money at stake.
attention.includes: Only areas in the session's access.
attention.period: Mixed — each item says which clock it is on.

signals.label: Planning signals
signals.what: What the next few weeks look like from today's records.
signals.how: Expected to close: open deals whose expected close date is this calendar month. Trajectory: the last three months of net cash. Obligations: installments due in 30 days and payroll open. Workload: open items due in the next 7 days, by member. Capacity: approved leave starting in the next 14 days.
signals.includes: Forecasts from dated records only. Nothing here is a projection.

clock.label: Clocks
clock.what: Why sections on this page carry different dates.
clock.how: Deals and Enquiries are live and run on the real clock. Finance and Team are frontend-first seeds and run on their own fixed clocks, so the same period lands on different calendar dates in each. A custom range is absolute and applies to every source as written.
clock.includes: Each section stamps its own clock beside its title.
